fusions.name: Thrown Mantle
fusions.desc: Throws your weighted surcoat over the target, dealing 10 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Unravel
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 16 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at 3 tiles. It uses up all your afflictions on the target, dealing 50% more for each one, and leaves it [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Quilted Layers
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage, up to 8 blows, for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 5% while it holds.

fusions.name: Woven Gambeson
fusions.desc: Conjures a padded coat under your plate: every hit you take is 1 lower, your armour rises by 6%, your dodge chance rises by 5%, and 2% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
